content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the ICMR NIRWoH Various Posts Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 05-10-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of ICMR NIRWoH to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the ICMR-National Institute for Research on Women's Health (ICMR NIRWoH) for temporary project positions in Mumbai and Sikkim.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post available in ICMR NIRWoH recruitment?
faq.answer: The available post for this recruitment drive is Project Technical Support - I, with vacancies distributed across different study locations.

faq.question: Q3. How many total vacancies are announced?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies available for the Project Technical Support - I position under this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the last date to apply online?
faq.answer: The last date for the submission of online applications is 05-10-2026. Candidates must complete their application before this deadline.

faq.question: Q5. What is the educational qualification required?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a three-year Graduate degree in Public Health or Epidemiology with one-year experience, or a Post Graduate Degree in Public Health or Epidemiology.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants applying for the Project Technical Support - I post is 28 years.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary offered for these posts?
faq.answer: The salary is Rs. 23,400/- for the Mumbai posting and Rs. 19,800/- for the Sikkim Study Site posting, inclusive of applicable HRA.

faq.question: Q8. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is strictly online through the official application portal provided by ICMR NIRWoH.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process includes the screening of submitted online applications followed by a physical interaction or online interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I apply for this job?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates can apply online by visiting the official link provided on the ICMR NIRWoH application portal.
